factor_scores.evidence_summary: Grove uses USDS SkyLink OFT. Helper defaults/tests use two required DVNs, optional threshold 0, confirmations 15, but live USDS OFT config was not read on-chain.
factor_scores.evidence_detail: No 1/1 DVN evidence found in Grove helper code; live endpoint config remains a verification gap.

factor_scores.evidence_summary: No immutable collateral-price oracle address found; dss-allocator fixed 1:1 oracle is a simple allocator primitive and governance-spell-adjustable per README.
factor_scores.evidence_detail: Grove controller does not embed a non-replaceable price feed for collateral acceptance.

factor_scores.evidence_summary: Grove is not a permissionless lending market accepting arbitrary pool prices as collateral.
factor_scores.evidence_detail: RWA allocator profile and source show whitelisted/rate-limited allocation flows, not permissionless collateral onboarding.

factor_scores.evidence_summary: Security-council threshold reduction/timelock removal scan requires multisig/timelock event reads; no public current event found, but the monitor is not available here.
factor_scores.evidence_detail: Grove registry exposes freezer/relayer/operator addresses and the profile notes signer thresholds are unresolved. No current public threshold-reduction report was found; proper scoring needs owner/threshold history event reads.
